items.title: Implement Unified JLDN Agent Governance & Dev Standards
items.details: Codified .agents/AGENTS.md and .dev/ generational architecture establishing unified JLDN development standards, [DOMAIN]-[TYPE]-[NN] taxonomy, macOS M1 environment rules, and maintenance session lifecycle triggers matching Vampire-Ruleset.

items.title: Setup GitHub Actions Markdown Link & Lint CI/CD Pipeline
items.details: Created GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow (.github/workflows/lint.yml) and automated audit script (.github/scripts/validate_workspace.py) to automatically validate internal anchor cross-references, verify backlog schemas, and lint Markdown syntax on every push and pull request to main.

items.title: Author Community & Editorial Guidelines (CONTRIBUTING.md)
items.details: Authored comprehensive CONTRIBUTING.md at the repository root detailing guidelines for tag-based ruleset contributions, conversion archives, PR requirements, Markdown standards, and Red Team audit review workflows.

items.title: Initialize Generational Versioning Schema & Hub Architecture
items.details: Initialized GVS 2606.1.0-bs baseline, root CHANGELOG.md, .gitattributes LF normalization, .gitignore policies, and Generation 2606 development hub.

items.title: Standardize Root Monorepo pnpm-workspace.yaml Packages Configuration
items.details: Configured root pnpm-workspace.yaml with `packages: ['.web']` and unified build allowances to ensure clean workspace package resolution from root.

items.title: Consolidate Architecture Blueprint Map into Generational Hub
items.details: Removed redundant root-level tmv-architecture.map.json in favor of canonical .dev/2606/book-maps/tmv-architecture.map.json to keep repository root clean.

items.title: Migrate .ag/ Directory Contents to .agents/ and Update References
items.details: Migrated historical notes from .ag/notes/ (full_file_audit.md, project_audit.md) into .agents/notes/, updated all internal path references from .ag/ to .agents/, and removed the legacy .ag/ folder.

items.title: Update CI/CD Validator for docs/ and .books/ SRD Lifecycle
items.details: Enhanced .github/scripts/validate_workspace.py to validate frontmatter schemas, parent_ruleset_file linkages, and micro-anchors across docs/2606/ and supplements matching Vampire-Ruleset's CI validator.

items.title: Create Official Git Release Tag for Baseline v2606.1.0-bs
items.details: Create official Git release tag (v2606.1.0-bs) on GitHub marking the completion of JLDN dev standards, agent governance, and generational architecture setup.
